propos: Two levels, never mixed: the palette holds the values, roles hold the meaning.
regle: One theme, “Night”. A component never calls the palette: a role references it through var(), and a component always calls a role.
roles-propos: The only level a component calls.
etats-propos: A state has no colour of its own: it points to the role that holds one. Adding a state therefore never adds a hue.
voile-opacite: scrim opacity, the only value in this list that is not a colour.

groupe.semantique: Attention, success, danger, information, network, neutral

usage.fond-2: Card, round button, field, card row
usage.texte-2: Secondary text: meta, source, English title
usage.sur-titre: Text on a light fill: transient message
usage.filet: Field, pill and secondary button border
usage.nuit-fond: Screen background; text on the accent
usage.nuit-bloc: Card, round button, field, card row
usage.nuit-bloc-releve: Day thread track, avatar, “EN” tag, icon chip, rule between rows
usage.nuit-filet: Field, pill and secondary button border
usage.nuit-neutre-marque: Agenda slot in the thread, upcoming session node
usage.nuit-accent: Countdown, active tab, chosen day, primary button, my session
usage.nuit-attention-bloc: “Replaced by…” banner background: attention at 12% on the background
usage.papier-jaune: Highlighted passage on the PDF page

palette-propos: Exact values from the Night mock-up, plus the two paper colours a PDF page keeps.
